description: Search the catalogue of new-build projects in Cyprus (the same projects the site shows). Filter by district, neighbourhood or zone, starting price in euros (before VAT), distance to the sea, construction status and kind of home. Returns matching projects with starting price, homes, status, distances and page path. Use it for any question about what is available where or for how much.

limit.description: How many projects to return (default 6, max 12).

max_price_eur.description: Highest starting price, euros before VAT.

max_sea_km.description: Furthest distance to the sea in km (0.6 = walking distance).

min_price_eur.description: Lowest starting price, euros before VAT.

place.description: A neighbourhood or zone name or id, in Hebrew or English (e.g. 'גרמסוגיה', 'Kato Paphos', 'limassol-east', 'קורל ביי').

name: search_projects
title: Search new-build projects in Cyprus
